name: opengeni
description: Offload long-running or parallel work from your coding agent to an OpenGeni workspace, and build products on OpenGeni agents.

base_url.title: OpenGeni URL
base_url.description: Origin of your OpenGeni deployment, without a trailing slash. Use https://app.opengeni.ai for OpenGeni Cloud.

workspace_id.title: Workspace ID
workspace_id.description: The UUID after /workspaces/ in the OpenGeni address bar when the workspace you want to use is open.
